prerequisites: Fluency with linear algebra and geometry content taught in high school.

learning_outcomes.text: Recognize and understand the basic methodologies of linear algebra; geometry; differential geometry; differential and integral calculus; differential and partial differential equations; numerical methods; numerical algorithms; statistics, and optimization that are applied to engineering.
Solve, using mathematics and statistics, the possible problems that may arise in engineering.
Act effectively in a multilingual and multidisciplinary team.
Propose creative solutions to satisfactorily respond to real needs and problems of society.
Develop professional texts and scientific-technical reports according to the conventions of the field of industrial technical engineering.
Adapt the organization of content and the use of language, verbal and non-verbal, to argue in diverse situations or before diverse audiences.
Apply the knowledge of industrial engineering in learning new methods and theories.
Critically and constructively show the advantages and opportunities of different solutions to the same problem.

syllabus_topics: Ways to express a complex number
Definition of matrix and special types of matrices
Calculation of the inverse of a matrix by determinants
Operational comparison between Cramer's rule and Gaussian elimination method
Parametric equations of a vector subspace
Implicit equations of a vector subspace
Coordinates of a vector in a basis
Matrix expression of a linear mapping
Matrix associated with the composition of linear mappings
Changes of basis in linear mappings
Characterization of injective mappings by rank
Characterization of surjective mappings by rank
Characterization of bijective mappings by rank
Introduction to the problem of diagonalization
Affine variety generated by a set
Coordinates of a point in a reference
Matrix of a bilinear form with respect to a basis
Change of basis in bilinear forms
Orthogonal vectors with respect to a bilinear form
Scalar product in a vector space
Change of reference matrix in conics
Change of reference matrix in quadrics
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment will be carried out through the evaluation of two written tests. Each written test will have a relative weight of 50% of the final grade.
